findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_company" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Registry details of one Cyprus company or partnership: name, type, status and its date, registration date, registered office address, number and roles of current officers (no names), previous officers count, the date of the open data, and links to the company page and to order its documents." → after: "Registry details of one Cyprus company or partnership: name, type, status and its date, registration date, registered office address, number and roles of current officers (no names), the date of the open data, and links to the company page and to order its documents."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
